<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="paBNwtnfepSDUcZBYcCA"> <mxGraphModel dx="1483" dy="816" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" background="light-dark(#ffffff, #121212)" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "
@startuml
title BrewLite - Domain Class Diagram

class User {
 +id: String
 +email: String
 +name: String
 +password: String
 +role: Role
 +loyaltyPoints: Int
 +createdAt: DateTime
 +updatedAt: DateTime
}

class Product {
 +id: String
 +name: String
 +description: String
 +imageUrl: String
 +price: Float
 +stock: Int
 +createdAt: DateTime
 +updatedAt: DateTime
}

class Cart {
 +id: String
 +clientId: String
 +createdAt: DateTime
 +updatedAt: DateTime
}

class CartItem {
 +id: String
 +cartId: String
 +productId: String
 +quantity: Int
 +size: String
 +toppings: String
 +createdAt: DateTime
 +updatedAt: DateTime
}

class Order {
 +id: String
 +userId: String
 +total: Float
 +status: String
 +customerName: String
 +customerPhone: String
 +pickupType: String
 +tableNumber: String
 +note: String
 +paymentMethod: String
 +createdAt: DateTime
 +updatedAt: DateTime
}

class OrderItem {
 +id: String
 +orderId: String
 +productId: String
 +quantity: Int
 +size: String
 +toppings: String
 +unitPrice: Float
 +lineTotal: Float
 +createdAt: DateTime
}

class Payment {
 +id: String
 +orderId: String
 +amount: Float
 +method: String
 +status: String
 +idempotencyKey: String
 +createdAt: DateTime
 +updatedAt: DateTime
}

class Promotion {
 +id: String
 +code: String
 +discountType: String
 +discountValue: Float
 +startAt: DateTime
 +endAt: DateTime
 +isActive: Boolean
}

class LoyaltyTransaction {
 +id: String
 +userId: String
 +points: Int
 +type: String
 +createdAt: DateTime
}

enum Role {
 USER
 ADMIN
}

enum OrderStatus {
 PENDING
 CONFIRMED
 COMPLETED
 CANCELLED
}

enum PaymentStatus {
 PENDING
 SUCCESS
 FAILED
}

enum PaymentMethod {
 CASH
 WALLET
 CARD
}

User \"1\" -- \"0..*\" Order : places
Order \"1\" *-- \"1..*\" OrderItem : contains
Product \"1\" -- \"0..*\" OrderItem : referenced by

Cart \"1\" *-- \"0..*\" CartItem : contains
Product \"1\" -- \"0..*\" CartItem : referenced by

Order \"1\" -- \"0..*\" Payment : payments
User \"1\" -- \"0..*\" LoyaltyTransaction : earns
Promotion \"0..*\" -- \"0..*\" Order : applies to

@enduml
